description: Catalog of Johns Hopkins Turbulence Databases (JHTDB) datasets available for point queries — forced isotropic turbulence, channel flow, MHD turbulence, transitional boundary layer, atmospheric boundary layer and wind-farm LES, and more. Each entry gives the dataset code to pass to jhtdb_point_query, its spatial domain (x/y/z ranges, in the dataset's native simulation units), grid resolution, time range, and which physical fields (velocity, pressure, magnetic field, temperature, ...) it carries.
name: jhtdb_datasets
title: Jhtdb Datasets
